raw.query: WITH raw AS (SELECT CASE WHEN d.run_id LIKE '%head2k%' THEN 'steady_head2k' WHEN d.run_id LIKE '%burst1%' THEN 'burst1' END AS traffic_window, CASE WHEN d.run_id LIKE '%vision_%' THEN 'vision_aic' WHEN d.run_id LIKE '%llm_%_aic_%' OR d.run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src' THEN 'language_aic' END AS series, CASE WHEN d.run_id LIKE 'srcbuild:%' THEN 1 ELSE (regexp_match(d.run_id, '_s([0-9]+)$'))[1]::int END AS speedup, p.sla_metric, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id = d.run_id AND p.is_current = d.is_current WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND (d.experiment = 'sweeps' OR d.run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src') AND (d.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:vision_head2k_s%' OR d.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:vision_burst1_s%' OR d.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:llm_head2k_aic_s%' OR d.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_s%' OR d.run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src')), probes AS (SELECT r.traffic_window, r.series, r.speedup, min(r.n_requests) AS n_requests, bool_and(r.p99_ms < b.bound_ms) AS meets_all_slas FROM raw r JOIN provenance.v_sla_bound b USING (sla_metric) GROUP BY r.traffic_window, r.series, r.speedup), knees AS (SELECT traffic_window, series, count(*) AS n_speedup_probes, min(n_requests) AS requests_per_probe, max(speedup) AS max_tested_speedup, max(speedup) FILTER (WHERE meets_all_slas) AS largest_passing_speedup, min(speedup) FILTER (WHERE NOT meets_all_slas) AS first_failing_speedup FROM probes GROUP BY traffic_window, series), per_window AS (SELECT traffic_window, max(n_speedup_probes) FILTER (WHERE series='vision_aic') AS vision_probes, max(n_speedup_probes) FILTER (WHERE series='language_aic') AS language_probes, max(requests_per_probe) FILTER (WHERE series='vision_aic') AS vision_requests_per_probe, max(requests_per_probe) FILTER (WHERE series='language_aic') AS language_requests_per_probe, max(max_tested_speedup) FILTER (WHERE series='vision_aic') AS vision_max_tested, max(largest_passing_speedup) FILTER (WHERE series='vision_aic') AS vision_largest_pass, max(first_failing_speedup) FILTER (WHERE series='vision_aic') AS vision_first_fail, max(max_tested_speedup) FILTER (WHERE series='language_aic') AS language_max_tested, max(largest_passing_speedup) FILTER (WHERE series='language_aic') AS language_largest_pass, max(first_failing_speedup) FILTER (WHERE series='language_aic') AS language_first_fail FROM knees GROUP BY traffic_window) SELECT w.*, CASE WHEN w.vision_first_fail IS NULL AND w.vision_largest_pass IS NOT NULL AND w.language_first_fail IS NOT NULL THEN w.vision_largest_pass::numeric / w.language_first_fail END AS strict_knee_ratio_lower_bound, g.static_encoder_workers_effective, g.binding_window_effective, g.static_as_ingested, g.binding_as_ingested FROM per_window w CROSS JOIN provenance.v_grid_static_effective g ORDER BY w.traffic_window DESC
raw.observed: On steady_head2k, 6 vision and 5 language speedup probes each contain 2,000 requests; vision still passes at s=32 with no observed failure, while language passes at s=2 and first fails at s=3, giving a strict knee-ratio lower bound of 10.666666666666666. On burst1 both first fail at s=1.
raw.claimed: Saturation knees an order of magnitude apart on steady traffic.
raw.evidence: After filtering is_current=true and superseded_by IS NULL, the calibrated steady sweep establishes vision knee >=32 and language knee <3 in trace-speedup units, hence separation >32/3 = 10.666666666666666; the burst breakdown does not support this ratio but is outside the claim's steady-traffic scope.
